posts.title: The iPhone X and its many X factors
posts.content:
In 2017, Apple launched what many still call its most influential iPhone yet — the iPhone X (pronounced iPhone Ten, not iPhone Ex 😅). It wasn't just a new model. It was a full-blown design reset, breaking away from the ageing iPhone 6 aesthetic that had lingered since 2014.

Sure, Android had many of the same features before — but in typical Apple fashion, they didn’t just adopt them; they refined them.

Let’s explore how the iPhone X redefined smartphones and why, even in 2025, it’s still one of the best entry-level iPhones available today.

🔁 The First Truly Buttonless iPhone

The iPhone X wasn’t just another iPhone — it was a bold reinvention. It became the first iPhone to remove the physical Home button entirely, replacing it with a gesture-based navigation system. This allowed Apple to deliver an edge-to-edge OLED Super Retina display that looked futuristic and felt intuitive.

This design decision:

  • Changed how users interacted with their iPhones
  • Opened the door for Face ID
  • Influenced every iPhone model that followed

Even now, Apple’s latest iPhones still follow the design language pioneered by the X.

👁 Face ID: Biometrics, Reimagined

Along with the home button went Touch ID. In came Face ID — a secure 3D facial recognition system powered by Apple’s TrueDepth camera. It works in low light, adapts to your appearance, and enables features like Animoji and Memoji.

Sure, Android had face unlock first, but Apple’s version was:

  • More secure
  • More consistent
  • Usable for Apple Pay and secure apps

It redefined biometric authentication on smartphones.

🧠 Augmented Reality Made Real

With the iPhone X, Apple also introduced ARKit, bringing augmented reality (AR) to millions of users for the first time. From immersive gaming to educational tools and even furniture shopping, AR became more than a gimmick — it became useful.

The iPhone X helped prove that AR could be mainstream.

⚡️ Wireless Charging Comes to iPhone

Yes, Android beat Apple to it — but the iPhone X was the first iPhone to support wireless charging using the Qi standard. This made charging more convenient and laid the foundation for Apple’s later MagSafe ecosystem.

💸 Why the iPhone X Still Makes Sense in 2025

Even in 2025, the iPhone X remains:

  • Sleek and modern in design
  • Smooth in performance with iOS 16–17
  • Ideal for everyday users, teens, or anyone entering the Apple ecosystem

With Face ID, a beautiful OLED display, and wireless charging — all for under ₦150,000, the iPhone X is a serious bargain.

posts.title: Don’t Let These Six Mistakes Ruin Your Smartphone
posts.content:
In today’s fast-paced world, our smartphones are an essential part of our lives. They help us stay connected to the world, stay on top of our work, and entertain us on the go. However, many of us may not realise that our actions can have a significant impact on the lifespan of our phones. Here are six things you do that affect the lifespan of your phone.

Not Using a Phone Case

One of the most common reasons for smartphone damage is dropping the phone. Honestly, we get it; in most cases, the phone case diminishes the beauty of the phone, and your sleek-looking S23 Ultra becomes less aesthetically pleasing once you slap a case on it. Unfortunately, without a protective case, your phone is more susceptible to scratches and cracks, reducing lifespan. Investing in a good phone case can protect your phone from accidental drops and other damage.

Ignoring Software Updates

Conversely, software Updates are essential for the performance and security of your smartphone. They fix bugs, provide new features, and enhance the overall user experience. Ignoring software updates can cause your phone to become slower, less secure, and more prone to crashes.

Overcharging your phone

In addition, your battery is one of the most critical components in your phone. We have discussed habits that ruin your battery here; for iPhone users, we have tips to keep your battery purring here and what to do if your battery life falls below 85% here. Yes, we love you that much, and you are welcome. Charging your phone overnight or leaving it plugged in for extended periods can damage the battery, reducing its lifespan. It’s best to unplug your phone once fully charged, as overcharging can cause the battery to overheat, leading to potential damage or a fire hazard.

Running too many apps in the background

Regardless of your phone’s RAM size, running too many apps in the background can cause your phone to slow down, drain the battery faster, and reduce its lifespan. It’s best to close unused apps and limit the number of apps running in the background. Multitask responsibly.

Exposing your phone to extreme temperatures

Exposing your phone to extreme temperatures, whether hot or cold, can cause damage to the battery and other components, reducing its lifespan. Avoid leaving your phone in a hot car or direct sunlight for extended periods and exposing it to extremely cold temperatures.

Neglecting screen protection

Your phone’s screen is one of the most expensive parts to repair if it gets cracked or scratched (Ask any Samsung phone user). Not only that, but a damaged screen can also affect your phone’s functionality and appearance. Invest in a good screen protector and a durable case to protect your screen from harm. Screen protectors can prevent scratches and cracks, while cases can absorb shocks and drops. If you end up breaking your screen, repair it as soon as possible to avoid further damage.

Exposing your phone to water or dust

Unsurprisingly, water and dust are two of the biggest enemies of your phone. They can get into your phone’s ports, speakers, microphone, and camera and cause corrosion, short circuits, or malfunctions. Even if your phone is water-resistant or waterproof, exposing it to water or dust unnecessarily is not a good idea. Avoid using your phone in wet or dusty environments, such as bathrooms, pools, beaches, or construction sites to prevent water or dust damage. If you get your phone wet or dirty, dry it off gently with a soft cloth and avoid turning it on until it’s completely dry.

Keeping too many apps

Having more apps on your phone gives you more options and convenience, but it can also slow down your phone and take up valuable storage space. Too many apps can run in the background and drain your battery, use up your data, and interfere with other functions. To free up some space and speed up your phone, remove apps you don’t use or need. You can also disable or uninstall preinstalled apps that came with your phone.

In conclusion, our smartphones are essential to our lives, and we want them to last as long as possible. By taking care of our phones, such as using a phone case, keeping the software up to date, avoiding overcharging, cleaning the phone regularly, limiting the number of apps running in the background, and avoiding extreme temperatures, we can ensure that our phones last longer and continue to provide us with the benefits we need.

posts.title: How to Reset Apple AirPods Max: A Complete Guide
posts.content:
Are you experiencing problems with your Apple AirPods Max and want to reset them? Resetting your AirPods Max can help fix various issues and get them working properly again. In this article, we will show you step-by-step how to reset your Apple AirPods Max with alternative methods if the issue is unresolved.

Introduction

Apple AirPods Max is a popular and innovative pair of wireless headphones with high-quality sound and noise cancellation features. Despite their excellent design and performance, some users encounter problems with their AirPods Max, which range from connectivity issues to sound problems or one or more unexplainable issues.

Resetting Apple AirPods Max

Before we dive into the reset process, it's essential to know when and why to reset your AirPods Max. Some reasons for resetting your AirPods Max may include:

  • Connectivity issues with your device
  • Sound problems
  • Pairing issues
  • Incorrect battery readings

Resetting your AirPods Max may help resolve these issues and get your headphones working correctly again.

How to Reset Apple AirPods Max

Resetting your AirPods Max is relatively easy and can be done in a few simple steps:

  1. Place your AirPods Max in their Smart Case.
  2. Close the Smart Case and wait for at least 15 seconds.
  3. Take the Airpods Max out of the smart case, press and hold the digital crown and the setup button of the Airpods Max until the status light flashes amber.
  4. Release the setup button and wait for your AirPods Max to show the white flashing light.
  5. Put the Airpods Max back into its case.

Congratulations! You have now successfully Reset your Apple AirPods Max.

Alternative Methods to Reset Apple AirPods Max

If you are unable to reset your AirPods Max using the method above, there are alternative ways to reset them. You can use Siri to reset your AirPods Max by saying, "Hey Siri, reset my AirPods." Let me know in the comments below if that works

Conclusion

Resetting your Apple AirPods Max can help fix various issues and get them working properly again. By following the steps mentioned above, you can reset your AirPods Max with ease.

At OgaBassey, we believe that providing top-quality customer care is just as important as offering affordable and accessible financing solutions. We hope this guide has been helpful in guiding you through the process of resetting your AirPods Max and ensuring optimal performance. If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. We're always here to help you get the most out of your devices.

If you still encounter issues with your AirPods Max, you can try troubleshooting them or contact Apple support for further assistance.

FAQs

  1. Will resetting my AirPods Max delete any of my saved data? No, resetting your AirPods Max will not delete any saved data on your connected devices.
  2. How do I reset my AirPods Max? To reset your AirPods Max, press and hold the noise control button and the Digital Crown button simultaneously until the LED light on the ear cups flashes amber, then white.
  3. Why would I need to reset my AirPods Max? You may need to reset your AirPods Max if you are experiencing connectivity issues or audio problems, or if you want to connect them to a new device.
  4. Will resetting my AirPods Max fix connectivity issues? Resetting your AirPods Max may help fix connectivity issues. If resetting does not work, try forgetting the device on your connected device and then reconnecting.
  5. Can I reset my AirPods Max with Siri? No, you cannot reset your AirPods Max with Siri. You need to manually press and hold the noise control button and the Digital Crown button to reset them.

I hope these FAQs provide helpful information for resetting your AirPods Max. If you have any other questions, please feel free to contact us.

posts.title: Six Mistakes to Avoid When Getting a New Phone
posts.content:
Choosing the right smartphone can be a daunting task, especially with the myriad of options available in the market today. It's easy to make common mistakes when purchasing a new phone, whether due to the allure of marketing gimmicks or overlooking crucial factors. In this blog post, we will explore six mistakes you should avoid when shopping for a new smartphone. By steering clear of these pitfalls, you can ensure a more informed and satisfying purchase.

Buying from a Dubious Dealer

To kick off our list, we must emphasize the significance of purchasing from reputable dealers. Unscrupulous dealers can jeopardize your smartphone experience, offering little to no device warranty and potentially selling tampered or counterfeit products. Always conduct thorough research and buy from trusted dealers who provide reliable warranties. Ogabassey offers a one-year warranty on both used and new devices..

Not Researching Enough

The internet has made information readily available, so there's no excuse for not conducting thorough research before buying a new phone. Relying solely on the manufacturer's marketing materials may not accurately represent the device's performance. Take advantage of user reviews, video demonstrations, and expert opinions to gain valuable insights into the phone you intend to purchase.

Neglecting Storage Options

In 2023, using a phone with anything less than 128GB of storage capacity is not recommended. Modern smartphones now boast powerful cameras that capture photos with immense detail, resulting in larger file sizes. Additionally, with the capability to shoot high-resolution 4K videos, storage requirements have significantly increased. Neglecting adequate storage can hinder your ability to store precious memories and media on your device. Opt for sufficient storage capacity, as 64GB may no longer meet your needs.

Neglecting Network Capabilities

When purchasing a phone, it's essential to consider its network compatibility, especially when buying a used or imported device. Verify if the phone is factory unlocked, chip-locked (in the case of iPhones), or globally unlocked. Additionally, pay attention to the supported network bands, as incompatible bands can affect your ability to access network-dependent services such as calling and internet usage. Ensure your chosen phone aligns with the network requirements of your region.

Focusing Solely on Specs

While specifications play a role in determining a phone's performance, it's crucial not to get fixated solely on numbers. Processor speed and camera megapixels are not the sole indicators of a phone's capabilities. Instead, focus on real-world performance and the overall user experience. Consider factors like software optimization, battery life, and user interface to gauge how well the phone will integrate into your daily life.

Avoiding Futureproofing

Unless you have a generous budget for frequent upgrades, choosing a phone that offers longevity and futureproofing is vital. Look for features and technologies that are less likely to become obsolete quickly. Prioritize phones with robust software support, upgradeable storage options, and compatibility with emerging technologies. Investing in a phone with a longer lifespan will ensure you get the most value from your purchase.

When getting a new phone, it's essential to approach the decision-making process with caution. By avoiding the common mistakes outlined in this blog post, you can make a more informed choice and select a smartphone that meets your needs and expectations. Remember to buy from reputable dealers, conduct thorough research, consider storage and network capabilities, look beyond mere specifications, and prioritize futureproofing. By doing so, you'll be well on your way to enjoying a satisfying smartphone experience tailored to your preferences and requirements.

We'd love to hear from you! What factors do you consider most important when getting a new phone? Share your thoughts in the comment section.

posts.title: THE VR/AR HEADSET FOR THE 1%, Sad Day for iPhone X owners, and More News from Apple’s WWDC 2023

True to form, the 2023 WWDC (Worldwide Developers Conference) lived up to expectations, delivering an array of exciting announcements. Here are some of the standout highlights from the event:

Introducing the Apple Vision Pro

Unsurprisingly, Apple refers to it as a device for spatial computing (their fancy term for AR and VR). Early glimpses from videos and promotional material depict awe-inspiring hardware. If you happen to be reading this in Nigeria, brace yourself as the Apple Vision Pro comes with a hefty price tag of almost 3 million Naira. posts.title: Unveiling the Evolution of Intel Core Processors: A Journey through Generations
posts.content:
When choosing a Windows laptop, the decision often boils down to two processor options: AMD or Intel. While AMD continues to gain popularity for its price-to-performance ratio, Intel remains the more widely recognized choice. We're all familiar with Intel's iconic Core i3, i5, and i7 processors, where the i3 sits below the i5 but above the i7 in terms of power; we explained it all here. However, what about the 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, 11th, and 12th generations we hear about in the PC ads? Join us as we review Intel's generations, unraveling the incremental upgrades they bring to the table.

First Generation (Nehalem, 2008-2009): Unleashing New Possibilities

The journey of Intel Core processors began with the Nehalem microarchitecture, introducing the Core i3, i5, and i7 series. These processors marked a significant leap forward with improved performance, integrated memory controllers, and the advent of Hyper-Threading technology.

Second Generation (Sandy Bridge, 2011): Power Meets Efficiency

Sandy Bridge processors brought refined microarchitecture, enhanced performance, improved power efficiency, and introduced Turbo Boost Technology 2.0. This generation also witnessed the integration of Intel HD Graphics onto the processor die.

Third Generation (Ivy Bridge, 2012): Shrinking to Greatness

Building upon Sandy Bridge, Ivy Bridge introduced a smaller 22nm manufacturing process. It delivered improved graphics performance, USB 3.0 support, higher clock speeds, and a host of other advancements.

Fourth Generation (Haswell, 2013): Efficiency Refined

Haswell processors focused on power efficiency improvements and presented better integrated graphics performance. They also introduced a new socket type, LGA 1150, and advancements in overclocking capabilities.

Fifth Generation (Broadwell, 2014): Power Thriftiness Unleashed

Broadwell processors embraced a smaller 14nm manufacturing process, emphasizing significant gains in power efficiency. While the performance improvements were incremental, they made these processors ideal for mobile devices and laptops.

Sixth Generation (Skylake, 2015): Empowering the Future

Skylake processors came with DDR4 memory support, further advancements in power efficiency, enhanced integrated graphics performance, and native support for USB 3.1 and Thunderbolt 3. They paved the way for the next level of connectivity and performance.

Seventh Generation (Kaby Lake, 2016): Performance Optimization

Kaby Lake processors focused on optimizing performance and power efficiency without introducing major architectural changes. This generation ushered in support for 4K video playback and HDCP 2.2, enriching multimedia capabilities.

Eighth Generation (Kabylake-Refresh, Coffee Lake, 2017): The Core Gets Stronger

Coffee Lake processors raised the bar by introducing six-core processors in the mainstream lineup, along with higher clock speeds, improved power efficiency, and enhanced thermal management. They marked a significant leap forward in core counts.

Ninth Generation (Coffee Lake Refresh, 2018): Power Refined

Coffee Lake Refresh processors refined the ninth generation by offering higher core counts and improved performance across the board. These processors even introduced the first consumer-grade eight-core processors, elevating the standards for power and performance.

Tenth Generation (Comet Lake, Ice Lake, 2020): Innovation Unleashed

Comet Lake (Desktops) and Ice Lake (laptops) processors continued the trend of increased core counts, reaching up to ten cores for mainstream processors. They brought higher boost clock speeds, improved memory support, and enhanced AI capabilities. With technologies like Wi-Fi 6, Thunderbolt™ 3, USB 3.2 Gen 2x2, and DDR4-2933 memory support, these processors enable faster wireless, wired, and memory performance, enhancing data transfer, streaming, gaming, and multitasking experiences.

Eleventh Generation (Rocket Lake, Comet Lake-Refresh, Tiger Lake): Power Unleashed

The 11th Generation of Intel Core processors took performance and multitasking capabilities to new heights. Intel Core i9 desktop processors saw the maximum core count increase from ten to twelve. At the same time, integrated graphics performance and quality were significantly improved for processors featuring Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics or Intel® UHD Graphics 770. These processors embraced new features such as ray tracing, variable rate shading, adaptive sync, and integer scaling, delivering smoother gaming, streaming, and content creation experiences even on devices without discrete graphics cards.

12th Generation

The 12th Generation, comprising Alder Lake (Desktop and Mobile), Raptor Lake (Desktop), and Meteor Lake (Mobile), brought forth a new era of performance. Core counts were further increased, with Intel Core i9 desktop processors reaching up to sixteen cores and Intel Core i9 laptops boasting sixteen cores. This optimization led to unmatched performance and multitasking capabilities in gaming, content creation, and workstation applications.

Enhanced graphics performance and quality were once again a focus for Intel Core processors with Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics or Intel® UHD Graphics for 12th Gen Intel® Processors. The 12th Generation embraced cutting-edge features like ray tracing, variable rate shading, adaptive sync, and integer scaling. These advancements translated into seamless gaming, streaming, and content creation experiences, even without the need for discrete graphics cards.

The evolution of Intel Core processors across generations has been a journey of continuous improvement, pushing the boundaries of performance, power efficiency, and graphics capabilities. Each generation has brought incremental upgrades from Nehalem to Alder Lake and beyond, empowering users with more processing power and enhanced multimedia experiences. Whether you're a gamer, content creator, or professional seeking unparalleled performance, the generations of Intel Core processors have something to offer, taking your computing experience to new heights.

From capturing lecture notes to staying socially connected, these gadgets have become indispensable for a seamless university experience. In this article, we'll delve into the crucial tech essentials that every university student should consider having in their possession.

Laptop: Your Ultimate Academic Companion

Undoubtedly, a dependable laptop stands as the cornerstone of a university student's toolkit. It serves as your digital notebook, research hub, and presentation tool. When selecting a computer, factors such as processing power, storage, battery life, and portability should be taken into account. Our recommendations will be shaped by two key factors: your field of study and your budget. For instance, an Architecture student's needs will differ from those of an Education student. While a MacBook, especially the MacBook M1, suits those with ample budgets and an existing iPhone, Windows laptops like an 11th Gen Core i7, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, and dedicated Nvidia RTX graphics cater to more intensive tasks like model design and video editing.

For those on a budget, laptops like HP EliteBook, Dell Latitude, or Lenovo ThinkPad, with specifications such as a 7th Gen Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM, and 256GB SSD, provide practicality. However, remember that these budget laptops won't support high-end gaming, the odd FIFA 19 and other esports titles might run on mid to low settings, don’t expect these budget options to run AAA titles. Headphones/Earbuds: A Sanctuary for Studying

Whether you're absorbed in the library's buzz or enduring dormitory noise, premium headphones or earbuds can create a haven for concentration. Noise-cancelling technology elevates your focus while muting distractions. Options like the Bose QuietComfort series and Sony WH-1000XM4 offer superb over-ear headphones, while the Apple AirPods Pro and Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro provide excellent in-ear alternatives. Budget-friendly options from brands like Redmi, Xiaomi, Jabra, and Anker also exist.

Mobile Phone: Stay Connected and Organized

Your smartphone is more than a social device—it serves as your digital calendar, communication hub, and emergency lifeline. Prioritize phones with capable cameras for capturing study sessions or memorable moments. Recent models from Apple (such as the iPhone 14) or flagship/midrange Samsung offerings combine reliability, performance, and seamless device integration. Check out our reviews for detailed insights on options like iPhone 13 Pro,  Pixel 7A, iPhone X and the Samsung S23 Ultra. Speaker: Relish Leisure and Connection

When study sessions ease up, unwinding and socializing are vital. A portable speaker can instantly transform your room into a mini-party space or set the ambiance for studying. The Onyx speaker is celebrated for its sound quality and portability, while the JBL Flip series stands out with robust sound and sturdy build.

Portable Charger: Power for On-the-Go

With various devices demanding power, maintaining their charge can be challenging, especially during long campus days. A portable charger, also known as a power bank, comes to the rescue. Prioritize chargers with multiple ports and high capacity for all-encompassing device support. Reputable brands like Anker, Rosmoss, and Baseus offer reliable portable charging solutions.

Laptop Stand and External Keyboard: Ergonomic Bliss

Hours spent typing on a laptop can strain your posture and wrists. Enhance your comfort with a laptop stand and an external keyboard. This setup not only fosters better ergonomics but also enhances airflow, ensuring your laptop remains cool during extended use.

posts.title: 8 Things You Didn’t  Know Your iPhone Can Do
posts.content:
Introduction

The iPhone is one of the commonest phones in the world. The iPhone has over 80% of the smartphone market share in the United States alone. With each new model, Apple introduces innovative features that often go unnoticed. In this blog post, we will uncover five hidden capabilities of your iPhone that you might not have known about.

Measure Anything with Your iPhone.

Have you ever found yourself in a situation where you needed to measure something quickly, but you didn’t have a physical tape measure on hand? Well, your iPhone can come to the rescue! Introduced in iOS 12, the Measure app uses augmented reality (AR) technology to measure objects using your phone’s camera. Simply open the Measure app, point your iPhone at the object you want to measure, tap the starting point, and then drag the endpoint to your desired location. Your iPhone will provide an accurate measurement, making it a handy tool for DIY projects or even just measuring furniture to see if it fits in your space.

Hidden Magnifying Glass

For those moments when you need a magnifying glass to read the fine print, your iPhone can step in as a makeshift one. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Magnifier and enable it. Now, you can triple-click the side button (or home button on older models) to activate the magnifier. Use your camera to zoom in on small text, objects, or anything that requires a closer look. It’s a feature that can be a lifesaver when you forget your reading glasses.

Emergency SOS

Your iPhone can also double as a personal safety device. In an emergency, press the side button (or home button on older models) five times quickly, and your iPhone will call emergency services in your region. It will also send a message with your location to your emergency contacts, making it a valuable tool in critical situations.

Quick Camera Access from the Lock Screen

Have you ever missed a perfect photo opportunity because you couldn’t unlock your iPhone quickly enough? You can access the camera from the lock screen without unlocking your device. Swipe left on the lock screen, and your camera app will instantly open. This feature ensures that you never miss capturing those memorable moments.

Hidden Level Tool

 Your iPhone’s built-in Compass app has a hidden feature that acts as a spirit or bubble level. Open the Compass app and swipe left to reveal the level tool. This tool can help you hang pictures straight, ensure your bookshelves are level, or assist with any task that requires precise levelling.

Custom Vibrations

You may already know that you can customize ringtones, but can you also create custom vibrations for specific contacts? Go to Settings > Sounds & Haptics > Ringtone > Vibration and choose “Create New Vibration.” You can tap out your own pattern and then assign it to a contact in your Contacts app. This way, you can identify who’s calling or texting you without looking at your phone.

Scan Documents and Sign PDFs

With iOS’s built-in Notes app, you can easily scan documents using your iPhone’s camera. Open a note, tap the camera icon, and select “Scan Documents.” Your iPhone will automatically detect the document’s edges and create a digital scan. Additionally, you can sign PDFs directly on your iPhone using the Markup feature. When you open a PDF in the Mail app or another app that supports it, tap the markup icon (which looks like a pen tip) to add your signature or annotations.

Voice Unlocking

Did you know you can unlock your iPhone using just your voice? This feature, known as “Voice Control,” allows you to control your device using spoken commands, including unlocking it. To enable Voice Control, go to Settings > Accessibility > Voice Control and turn it on. You must set up a voice profile by following the on-screen instructions. Once Voice Control is set up, you can wake your iPhone by saying, “Hey Siri,” and then issue commands like “Open Messages” or “Unlock the phone.” Remember that Voice Control is highly secure and requires a unique voice print to work, ensuring that only your voice can unlock your iPhone. This feature is convenient and can be a great accessibility tool for individuals with mobility challenges who may have difficulty using physical buttons or touch gestures.

How many of these features are you familiar with? Did we miss out on anything? Tell us in the comment section

posts.content:
Introduction

In the dynamic world of smartphones, none commands the spotlight quite like Apple's iPhone. With a legacy of iconic unveiling events and a vast user base, the anticipation for the iPhone 15 is reaching a crescendo. Here's a glimpse of what we know so far about this highly-awaited release:

A Tradition Unchanged

We expect more of the same this year with some minor twitches here and there Mark your calendars, for this September promises to be unforgettable as the iPhone 15 makes its grand entrance on the 12th of September.

Four Models to Choose From

This lineup is rumored to include the standard iPhone 15, the larger iPhone 15 Plus, the feature-packed iPhone 15 Pro, and the formidable flagship, the iPhone 15 Pro Max (or possibly the iPhone 15 Ultra).

Farewell to Lightning, Welcome USB-C?

The European Union's push for standardized USB-C ports has finally reached Apple, with a mandate set for 2024. However, industry insiders suggest that Apple might embrace USB-C sooner, potentially with the iPhone 15. This shift promises significant benefits for content creators, as it will enhance wired file-sharing capabilities. Given that Apple's iPad and MacBook already rely on USB-C, this change seems both logical and long overdue.

Speed, Efficiency, and Performance

Apple's approach to battery life improvement differs from its competitors. Instead of increasing battery capacity, Apple prioritizes efficiency and optimization. The iPhone 15 is poised to take this further with the introduction of the A17 bionic SoC (processor), built on TSMC's cutting-edge 3nm process. This advancement will result in superior power management and efficiency, setting a new benchmark in performance, optimization, and battery management.

Camera Revolution

In the world of smartphone photography and videography, the iPhone 14 Pro Max held sway in 2022 and early 2023. However, the iPhone 15 is set to reclaim the throne, if rumors and leaks hold true. With a new periscope sensor and substantial camera optimizations, the iPhone 15 promises to shine in the AI-driven age, offering an unparalleled user experience.

Other Exciting Features

Apple's innovative spirit extends beyond the core functionalities. The Dynamic Island, introduced with the iPhone 14 Pro and Pro Max, is expected to undergo enhancements, delivering even more immersive experiences. Moreover, the iPhone 15 is rumored to feature a screen with a remarkable 2000nits brightness, setting new standards in visual quality. Brace yourselves for a device that will push boundaries and redefine excellence.

Conclusion

As we eagerly await the arrival of the iPhone 15, it's clear that Apple is poised to deliver yet another groundbreaking device. With a potential shift to USB-C, impressive performance gains, a camera poised to reclaim its throne, and a host of other exciting features, the iPhone 15 promises to be a game-changer in the world of smartphones.

posts.title: 8 Things You Didn\'t Know your Samsung Phone Could do
posts.content:
Introduction

Samsung, often dubbed the Apple of the Android world, commands an unrivaled presence in the Android ecosystem. With its extensive influence, this South Korean tech giant stands as the primary rival to Apple's iPhone in the smartphone realm. In fact, many argue that Samsung is the more innovative company when it comes to features and cutting-edge technology. While most users are well-acquainted with the basics of calling, texting, and web browsing, Samsung devices hold a treasure trove of hidden capabilities that can elevate your overall smartphone experience. In this article, we will uncover ten astonishing features you probably didn't know your Samsung device could perform. And for our Apple enthusiasts, we've got a similar blog post tailored just for you here.

Samsung DeX Mode: Transform Your Phone into a Desktop

Did you ever imagine that your Samsung smartphone could serve as a full-fledged desktop computer? Enter Samsung DeX (Desktop Experience) mode, a hidden gem that allows you to connect your device to a supported smart TV or monitor, instantly providing you with a desktop-like interface. You can use your phone as a mouse and keyboard, or connect external peripherals for an even more immersive experience. Samsung DeX may seem like a niche feature until you find yourself in a situation where it becomes indispensable.

Bixby Routines: Your Pocket Assistant

Similarly, Think of Bixby Routines as having a personal assistant right in your pocket. These automated routines can execute tasks based on your location, the time of day, or other triggers. For instance, you can instruct your device to switch to silent mode during meetings or activate Wi-Fi when you arrive home.

Samsung Secure Folder: Elevate Your Privacy

Secure Folder is a discreet sanctuary on your device where you can safeguard apps, photos, and files, all shielded by an extra layer of security. It's the perfect solution for keeping sensitive information safe, including those files you'd rather keep away from prying eyes.

Wirelessly Charge Other Phones and Devices

In addition, Did you know your Samsung device can serve as a power source for other phones and devices? Utilise its reverse-wireless charging capabilities to give a boost to your friends or family member's device when they're running low on battery. It's a true lifesaver in emergency situations.

One-Handed Mode

In an era where phones are getting larger, with many exceeding 6.2 inches diagonally, the struggle to use your device with one hand is real. Activate the One-Handed Mode to shrink the screen, making it easier to access apps and controls with just a thumb.

Screen Recording with Internal Audio

Screen capture is a valuable tool for creating tutorials or sharing content. Samsung devices offer the ability to record both the screen and internal audio without the need for third-party apps. This feature even lets you capture both internal and external audio simultaneously.

AR Emoji: Bring Your Emoji to Life

Add a personal touch to your messages with AR Emojis that closely resemble you. Your Samsung device can generate emojis that mirror your facial expressions and gestures, which you can use in instant messaging apps.

Ultra-Power Saving Mode

When you're in dire need of conserving battery life, the Ultra Power Saving Mode steps in. It restricts your device's functionality to essential apps and features, extending its usage when you're running low on power.

Conclusion

Samsung devices are a treasure trove of features and capabilities that can significantly enhance your daily life, making it more convenient, productive, and enjoyable. From the transformative DeX mode that turns your phone into a desktop computer to the creation of personalized AR Emojis, these hidden treasures can genuinely enrich your Samsung experience. So, take the time to explore your device's settings and uncover all the incredible feats it can accomplish. You might just discover that your Samsung device is even more potent and versatile than you initially thought. Which of these features do you use most frequently? Did we overlook any noteworthy features? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section below.

posts.title: Introducing the iPhone 15 Series: Apple\'s Next Evolution in Smartphones
posts.content:
Apple has officially unveiled its highly anticipated iPhone 15 lineup, and there's no doubt that these are the most impressive iPhones to date. While the iPhone 14 series was a solid upgrade with features like the Dynamic Island and enhanced camera sensors on the Pro models, it still felt like an evolution of the previous generation. Convincing iPhone 13 Pro Max users to switch to the 14 Pro Max was a tough sell, as it raised the question of whether it offered enough value for the money.

The iPhone 15 series, however, faces no such identity crisis. Unlike the 14 series, which felt like an evolution, the iPhone 15 is a true revolution. Here are five key reasons why you should switch to the iPhone 15 series:

 A New Definition of "Premium" Design

 The iPhone 15 series has rightfully earned the label of "premium" in the smartphone industry. It boasts an unparalleled design that is undeniably Apple's best yet. Apple describes the base models (iPhone 15 and 15 Plus) as follows: "For the first time in a smartphone, colour is infused throughout the back glass, creating five exquisite colours. The back glass undergoes an optimized dual-ion exchange process, followed by polishing with nanocrystalline particles and etching to create a luxurious, textured matte finish. The aerospace-grade aluminium enclosure features a new contoured edge that feels exceptionally comfortable in your hands, and the Ceramic Shield front cover remains tougher than any other smartphone glass." While the design retains the bar-shaped form of the 13 and 14 series, the matte finish offers a refreshing twist that will undoubtedly appeal to a wide range of users.

The Ultimate Camera Setup

 Building on the success of the iPhone 14 series, Apple has equipped all four models of the iPhone 15 series (15, 15 Plus, 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max) with a powerful 48MP primary camera. This move levels the playing field across the entire lineup, ensuring that all users enjoy exceptional camera capabilities. The Telephoto lenses on the 15 and 15 Plus offer 2X Optical Zoom, rendering the need for a third camera virtually obsolete. Apple's computational photography reaches new heights, allowing users to capture stunning portraits without switching to Portrait mode. Depth information is automatically captured when a person, dog, or cat is in the frame or when a user taps to focus. The resulting images rival the quality of DSLR photography, particularly in portrait and low-light scenarios.

Processor and Thermal Excellence for Gamers

Conversely, Apple has not held back when it comes to catering to hardcore gamers. The iPhone 15 series features the formidable A16 and A17 Pro Bionic processors in the standard and Pro models respectively, setting new standards for performance. Apple has also revamped the heat dissipation system to minimize throttling, ensuring that the iPhone can handle the most demanding AAA gaming titles with ease. While MacBooks have struggled to compete in the gaming arena, the iPhone 15 series sets a new benchmark. Qualcomm, the ball is in your court.

USB-C Arrives on iPhone

 It's a change many Apple enthusiasts have been anticipating, We also predicted it here and it's finally here. The iPhone 15 series marks the debut of USB-C on an iPhone, a move long overdue. Beyond the convenience of a single cable for all your devices, the iPhone now supports USB 3, enabling significantly faster data transfers to your MacBook. Charging capabilities also receive a substantial boost. Content creators, in particular, stand to benefit from this upgrade.

Exciting New Colours

Apple loves to refresh its iPhone colours, and the iPhone 15 series doesn't disappoint. It arrives with a vibrant palette, including pink, green, blue, yellow, and black. Whether you're bold and adventurous or prefer classic elegance, Apple has a colour option to match your personality.

The iPhone 15 is set to be available for pre-order later this month. Stay tuned for our hands-on and camera comparison videos on Instagram.

Are you planning to make the iPhone 15 your next smartphone? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

posts.title: 5 Things to Know Before Buying the iPhone 15
posts.content:
Apple's recent announcement of the iPhone 15 has set the internet abuzz. The phones have started hitting the shelves of vendors in Nigeria. While there's no denying the excitement surrounding the new iPhone 15 series, it's also crucial to approach this purchase with a dose of reality, especially since it's Apple we're talking about. Here are five key things you should be aware of before deciding to buy the iPhone 15.

    Not All USB-C Ports Are Created Equal

    The inclusion of USB-C ports in the iPhone 15 series is undoubtedly a noteworthy development. Apple has finally embraced the USB-C standard for its MacBooks and iPads, albeit with a slight twist. The USB-C ports on the iPhone 15 and 15 Plus are limited to USB 2.0, an outdated and notably slower standard—the same as the old lightning platform. To access the faster 10GB/s USB 3.0, you'll need to opt for the flagship iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max, thanks to their dedicated USB controllers within the A17 Pro Soc chipset.

    iPhone 15 and 15 Plus Aren't Clear Upgrades from iPhone 14

    Navigating the realm of iPhone upgrades can be somewhat perplexing. This year's vanilla models (the iPhone 15 and 15 Plus) share the same A16 Bionic SOC as last year's flagship models (the iPhone 14 Pro and 14 Pro Max). The camera configurations are nearly identical, with the exception of the additional telephoto lenses on the 14 Pros. Even the design aesthetics show striking similarities. While the iPhone 15s do introduce USB-C, as mentioned earlier, it's constrained to USB 2.0 speeds. If you're upgrading from a 14 series iPhone, the real advancement lies in the iPhone 15 Pro or 15 Pro Max.

    Some Features Are Location-Dependent

    Apple's innovative features, such as Roadside Assistance and Crash Detection, are not yet available in Nigeria. Crash Detection, introduced with the iPhone 14 series, automatically contacts emergency services in the event of a severe collision. The iPhone 15 includes a similar feature called Roadside Assistance, which allows you to request help during car troubles when you're outside of cellular or Wi-Fi coverage. These features are undoubtedly valuable in emergencies but are currently limited by location, and Nigeria is not among the supported countries.

    E-SIM Continues to Be an Option

    Last year, Apple introduced E-SIM-exclusive iPhones, a welcome addition for many users. Fortunately, physical SIM cards remain an option, and this approach continues with the iPhone 15 models. You can choose from E-SIM-exclusive models or models that support both traditional physical SIM cards and modern E-SIM technology. Understanding your specific needs is vital before making a selection.

    Trade-In Your Old iPhone for the iPhone 15

    If you're eager to become the proud owner of the newly launched iPhone 15 models, you may have the opportunity to trade in your old phone and make a minimal additional investment. Reach out to us via Instagram @ogabassey to explore this trade-in option.

posts.title: Tecno Phantom V Flip: What makes this Affordable phone Elegant
posts.content:
Tecno is breaking new ground with its first flip-style foldable phone, the Tecno Phantom V Flip, introduced at the “Perfect in Pocket” Nigerian launch event. Priced at ₦569,000, this device is making waves as a budget-friendly option, with a striking design, vivid colour options and functional features to provide an uncompromised user experience.

Tecno Phantom V Flip's Design & Display

The Phantom V Flip is equipped with a small 1.32-inch circular OLED external screen incorporated into its camera array. This design, while giving the phone a distinct look reminiscent of a smartwatch, restricts the screen's functionality to displaying widgets, notifications, and Tecno’s array of memojis and digital pets. Internally, users are greeted by a 6.9-inch foldable screen, boasting a 1080x2640 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and an elongated 22:9 aspect ratio. The phone supports Flex Mode, allowing for versatile usage in half-folded positions.

Colours

The Phantom V Flip is available in two captivating colour variants – Mystic Dawn (a shade of purple) and Iconic Black. Both variants are adorned with lychee-pattern leather material, which is not only tactilely pleasing but also practical, resisting fingerprints and concealing minor scratches, a marked improvement over the faux leather used in Tecno’s previous models. This attention to material and colour enhances the device's overall appeal, providing users with both style and substance.

What are the Phantom V flip's Hardware & Specifications?

Under the hood, the Phantom V Flip houses a MediaTek Dimensity 8050 SoC, coupled with 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. The device is powered by a 4,000mAh battery, supporting 45W charging. The camera system comprises a 64MP primary rear camera, a 13MP ultra-wide camera, and a 32MP inner selfie camera. Despite these specifications, the phone’s top-heavy design when unfolded and the placement of the camera array and power button warrant consideration.

Software Updates & Security

Tecno’s history with software updates raises concerns about the Phantom V Flip’s long-term viability. The company has assured users of two major Android updates over two years and three years of security updates. However, consistent and timely delivery of these updates is pivotal for maintaining user safety and trust, given the essential role of smartphones in our digital lives.

Price & Availability

With an introductory price of ₦569,000 in Nigeria, the Phantom V Flip offers an accessible entry into the foldable phone market. The device stands as a competitive option amidst rivals priced over ₦1,000,000 but faces challenges from other budget-friendly alternatives such as the Moto Razr 2023. While not officially released in the US, Tecno plans to launch the Phantom V Flip in several other markets, broadening its availability.

Conclusion

The Tecno Phantom V Flip emerges as a compelling budget option in the foldable phone segment, balancing distinctive design, vivid colours, and practical features. Its competitive pricing makes it an attractive choice for those looking to experience foldable technology. However, Tecno's adherence to software update commitments and the device’s market availability will be determining factors in its overall success and adoption. if you'd like to purchase the Tecno V Flip you can get it here

posts.title: Samsung or iPhone: Which One Is the Best for You in 2025?
posts.content:
Introduction

The perennial debate over the supremacy of Samsung and iPhone has been ongoing for years, and it continues to intensify as these tech giants release new models with each passing year. In 2025, the battle between Samsung and Apple rages on, with both companies pushing the boundaries of innovation.

 But which one is the best for you? In this blog post, we'll examine the strengths and weaknesses of each brand to help you make an informed decision.

Samsung: The Android Powerhouse

1. Diverse Product Range: One of the biggest advantages of choosing a Samsung device is the sheer variety available. From the budget-friendly Galaxy A series to the high-end Galaxy S and Note series, Samsung caters to a wide range of consumers with different needs and budgets. This means you can find a Samsung device that fits your specific requirements.

2. Customisation: Android, the operating system powering Samsung devices, is renowned for its flexibility and customization options. You can personalize your device with various widgets, themes, and launchers to create a unique smartphone experience. This is particularly appealing to users who enjoy tailoring their devices to their liking.

3. Innovative Features: Samsung has a history of introducing innovative features such as the S Pen, foldable displays, and exceptional camera technology. These innovations provide users with cutting-edge capabilities, making Samsung devices stand out in the crowd.

4. Affordability: While Samsung offers premium flagship models, they also provide cost-effective options. The mid-range and budget smartphones are often praised for their value, offering a good balance between performance and price.

iPhone: The Apple Ecosystem

1. Ecosystem Integration: Apple has mastered the art of creating an ecosystem that seamlessly connects its devices. If you own an iPhone, you can pair it with a MacBook, iPad, Apple Watch, and even AirPods. This integration allows for a consistent user experience across all Apple products.

2. Privacy and Security: Apple places a strong emphasis on user privacy and data security. Features like App Tracking Transparency and Face ID ensure that your data is well-protected. For users who prioritize security, the iPhone is a top choice.

3. Optimized Software-Hardware Combination: iPhones are known for their efficient performance, thanks to the tight integration of Apple's hardware and software. The latest A-series chips ensure that even older iPhone models remain responsive and fast.

4. Longevity: Apple tends to provide longer software support for its devices, meaning that your iPhone is likely to receive updates and improvements for several years. This can extend the life of your device and increase its resale value.

Making Your Choice

Ultimately, the decision between a Samsung and an iPhone in 2025 comes down to your specific needs and preferences. Here are some key considerations to help you decide:

 If you value customization and a wide product range, Samsung may be your best choice.

If you prioritize privacy, security, and ecosystem integration, the iPhone might be more suitable.

Consider your budget: Samsung offers a broader range of price points, while iPhones tend to be more expensive.

Think about the longevity of your device and how long you plan to keep it. Apple's software support may make iPhones more appealing for long-term use.

In Conclusion

The battle between Samsung and iPhone in 2025 is as intense as ever, and both brands have their unique strengths. To make the best decision, consider your individual needs, your budget, and the ecosystem you're most comfortable with. Whichever choice you make, rest assured that both Samsung and Apple continue to push the boundaries of technology, providing users with increasingly powerful and innovative devices.

posts.title: Unlocking Your Productivity: 5 Essential Factors for Choosing the Perfect Work Laptop
posts.content:
In today's fast-paced, technology-driven world, having the right laptop for work is essential. Whether you're a professional, a student, or a freelancer, the laptop you choose can significantly impact your productivity and overall work experience. With countless options on the market, selecting the perfect laptop can be a daunting task. To help you make an informed decision, here are five key factors to consider when choosing a laptop for work.

Purpose and Usage

The first and most crucial factor to consider when selecting a work laptop is understanding your specific needs and how you intend to use it. Laptops come in various shapes and sizes, each tailored to different tasks. Consider whether you need a laptop for general office work, content creation, graphic design, programming, or gaming. The more demanding your tasks, the more powerful your laptop should be.

For basic office tasks and web browsing, a budget-friendly, lightweight laptop with good battery life should suffice. However, if you plan on running resource-intensive applications or multitasking, you may need a laptop with a more robust processor, additional RAM, and a dedicated graphics card.

Portability

Portability is another critical factor, especially if you're frequently on the go. A lightweight and compact laptop can be a lifesaver during business trips, conferences, or daily commutes. Consider the laptop's size and weight, as well as its battery life. Ideally, you should aim for a laptop that offers at least 8 hours of battery life, ensuring you can work without being tethered to a power outlet.

Operating System

The choice of operating system often comes down to personal preference and the software you need for your work. The two major operating systems to consider are Windows and MacOS.

Windows is widely used and compatible with a broad range of software, making it a versatile choice for most professionals.

macOS is favoured by creative professionals for its sleek design and seamless integration with Apple's software and hardware.

Select an operating system that aligns with your work requirements and your comfort level with the interface.

Performance and Hardware

The laptop's performance is directly linked to the hardware it employs. Key hardware components to assess include:

Processor (CPU): Opt for a powerful processor like an Intel Core i7 (11th gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 7 (5000 or newer) for smooth multitasking and running demanding applications.

Memory (RAM): Ensure you have enough RAM to handle your workloads. 8GB is a good starting point, but 16GB or more is recommended for resource-intensive tasks.

Storage: Choose a Solid-State Drive (SSD) for faster data access and a Hard Disk Drive (HDD) for more storage space. A combination of both (SSD for the operating system and applications, HDD for files) can offer a good compromise.

Graphics Card (GPU): Consider a laptop with a dedicated GPU if your work involves graphics-intensive tasks like video editing or 3D rendering.

 Budget

Your budget is the final piece of the puzzle. Laptops come in a wide price range, and it's essential to strike a balance between performance and cost. While high-end laptops can offer cutting-edge performance, budget-friendly options can meet the needs of many professionals. Research different models and read reviews to find a laptop that offers the best value for your money.

Remember that investing in a quality laptop is akin to investing in your work productivity and comfort. Avoid making a rushed decision, and take the time to thoroughly research and test different models to find the one that best fits your needs.

In conclusion, choosing the right laptop for work involves considering your specific needs, portability, operating system preference, performance requirements, and budget. By carefully evaluating these factors, you can make an informed decision that will enhance your work efficiency and help you succeed in your professional endeavours.

posts.title: How to Force Restart Your iPhone: A Simple Solution for Common iPhone Issues
posts.content:
Experiencing issues with your iPhone can be frustrating, especially if it seems unresponsive or faulty. One effective solution that often resolves many common problems is performing a force restart. This blog post will guide you through the steps to safely and quickly force restart your iPhone.

What is a Force Restart?

A force restart is a way of rebooting your iPhone when it becomes unresponsive. It's different from a regular restart because it does not require you to interact with the screen or settings. This method is particularly useful if your device is frozen, not responding, or experiencing other software-related issues.

When to Use a Force Restart?

Consider a force restart if:

  • Your iPhone is frozen and unresponsive. The screen is stuck on the Apple logo.
  • Apps are crashing or not opening properly.
  • The device is experiencing glitches or unusual behaviour.

How to Force Restart Different iPhone Models:

1. iPhone 8 or later (including iPhone X, XR, XS, 11, 12, 13, and SE 2020):

  • Quickly press and release the Volume Up button.
  • Quickly press and release the Volume Down button.
  • Press and hold the Side button until the Apple logo appears, then release the button.

2. iPhone 7 and 7 Plus:

   - Press and hold both the Volume Down button and the Sleep/Wake (Side) button.

   - When the Apple logo appears, release both buttons.

3. iPhone 6s, SE (1st generation), and earlier models:

   - Press and hold both the Home button and the Top (or Side) button.

   - When the Apple logo appears, release both buttons.

Tips for a Successful Force Restart:

  • Be quick when pressing the Volume Up and Down buttons on newer iPhone models.
  • Be patient; it may take a few seconds for the Apple logo to appear.
  • Ensure your iPhone has enough battery charge; if it's low, charge it for a bit before attempting a force restart.
  • Do not perform a force restart while updating iOS.

A force restart is a simple and effective solution for resolving many common iPhone issues. If your iPhone continues to experience problems after a force restart, consider contacting Apple Support or visiting an authorized service provider for further assistance.

posts.title: 4 SIMPLE TIPS TO TAKE BETTER PICTURES ON YOUR SMARTPHONE
posts.content:
Welcome to the ever-evolving realm of Smartphone Photography in the year 2024. Technological strides have propelled this art form to new heights, particularly with the advent of groundbreaking innovations like computational photography. In today's fast-paced world, capturing images reminiscent of budget laptop webcams is simply unacceptable. Elevate your photography game with the following techniques, transforming you from an amateur enthusiast to a skilled boss-level shooter.

Steer Clear of Flash Photography

Let's kick things off with a bit of controversy. While flash can be a lifesaver in low-light situations, its drawbacks often outweigh the benefits. The harsh and unnatural lighting it produces, coupled with color washout and the dreaded red-eye effect, can detract from the overall quality of your photos. Opt for natural or ambient light whenever possible to achieve more authentic and visually appealing results.

Optimize Lighting Conditions

The pivotal role of lighting in photography cannot be overstated. Even the most advanced smartphones may struggle in suboptimal lighting. Embrace natural light, especially during the golden hour (early morning or late evening), to infuse your images with a soft and flattering glow.

Discover Flattering Angles

Unless you've hit the genetic jackpot, everyone has a preferred angle that showcases their best features. Make a conscious effort to capture your subjects from their most flattering perspectives. This simple adjustment can significantly enhance the overall quality of your photographs.

Maintain a Clean Lens

It may sound surprising, but maintaining a clean lens is a game-changer. Smartphones, regardless of their design, have an uncanny ability to attract dust and grime. Cloudy lenses can adversely impact your photo quality. Regularly cleaning your camera lenses will ensure that your smartphone performs at its best, delivering crisp and clear images.

posts.title: Samsung Galaxy S24: Does Size Really Matter?
posts.content:
In a world where top-of-the-line smartphones usually measure anywhere around 6.8 to 6.9 inches, compact smartphones that pack all the bells and whistles are increasingly becoming a rarity. Enter the Asus Zenphone line and the vanilla version of the S24 series. While the Zenphone, currently in its 10th iteration (?), is a flagship killer, the Samsung S24 makes no such pretensions—this is a flagship; a feature-laden premium device that offers the best technology available from Samsung. How much does it deviate from its bigger sibling, and what compromises did Samsung make to miniaturize the S24 Ultra?

  • Screen

This, and by extension, size, is the primary difference between the S24 trio. The awe-inspiring S24 Ultra has a 6.8-inch display with a respectable 88.5% screen-to-body ratio. The S24+, slightly smaller with a 6.7-inch display, boasts a more impressive 91.6% screen-to-body ratio and a significantly higher 513 pixel-per-inch (PPI) density. The two devices also sport QHD screens. The S24, the baby of the house, has a modest 6.2-inch FHD screen with a relatively lower 416 PPI. Interestingly, the three devices use the same screen technology: a 120Hz dynamic LTPO 2X AMOLED screen. These screens can refresh as high as 120Hz and as low as 1Hz, depending on the content being displayed.

With the S24, you will miss out on a QHD screen, which might be a plus for some because a lower resolution, by default, means better battery life (more on that later). For those with smaller hands, the S24 is a great device. You will benefit from a tested and trusted Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 (the top-of-the-line, Armor is exclusively for the Ultra this year).

  • Performance

As far as performance is concerned, all fingers are equal here. All the S24 series have the same processor, a custom-made (reads overclocked) Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor. In the Android world, this is the greatest of the greatest and will be the processor of choice for the majority of flagship devices this year. Early benchmark results suggest this might even be a faster processor than Apple’s Bionic A17 processor in the iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max. Interestingly, the Samsung S24 will theoretically get better gaming performance because of its slightly lower resolution. Regardless, this is a phone that is future-proofed. In 3-5 years, it will still be purring efficiently—Samsung, oh, purr!

  • Camera

Every smartphone enthusiast knows that cameras are the biggest feature of any new release. Well, the S24+ and the S24 have the same camera setup: 50 MP, f/1.8, 24mm (wide), 1/1.56", 1.0µm, Dual Pixel PDAF, OIS, 10 MP, f/2.4, 67mm (telephoto), 1/3.94", 1.0µm, PDAF, OIS, 3x optical zoom, 12 MP, f/2.2, 13mm, 120˚ (ultrawide), a triple-camera system that differentiates them from the quad-camera setup of the S24 Ultra (with a different primary lens and a 5X optical zoom lens). Make no mistake; this is a flagship camera, and you will have no regrets whatsoever. It will perform in both good light and challenging light situations.

  • Battery

Small but mighty will be the appropriate moniker for the S24. Of the three phones, the S24 has the smallest battery capacity with its 4000 mAh battery. But with the efficiency of the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 and the smaller screen on the S24, a full day's usage is more than guaranteed.

  • Other Features

The headlining feature of the S24 series is the Galaxy AI, and it is available on all three. You can use the same Generative AI, circle to search, and real-time translation on all phones. You are not missing out on most of the goodies, and the best part is the S24 is the cheapest of the three. What you will lose in extra screen real estate, resolution, and the main camera sensor, you will gain in an inexpensive yet capable and easy-to-use smartphone. If you have a small palm, the boxy and gigantic frame of the S24 Ultra might not be your cup of tea.

Is the S24 a device you might consider? Is there anything you wished it had? Tell us in the comment section.

posts.title: Maximizing Mobile Storage: Practical Tips for iPhones and Samsung Devices
posts.content:
In the era of ever-evolving smartphones, storage space has become a valuable commodity. Whether you're an iPhone enthusiast or a dedicated Samsung user, running out of storage can be a frustrating experience. Fortunately, there are several strategies you can employ to optimize and expand your device's storage capacity. In this blog post, we'll explore practical solutions for resolving storage issues on both iPhones and Samsung devices. But, let’s be honest, it’s 2024, and you shouldn’t be using a phone with storage of less than 128GB

iPhones

  • Utilise iCloud Storage

One of the easiest ways to free up space on your iPhone is by taking advantage of iCloud storage. iCloud allows you to store photos, videos, and documents in the cloud, keeping them accessible from any device while freeing up valuable space on your phone. To enable iCloud, go to Settings, tap on your Apple ID, select iCloud, and choose the apps and data you want to store in the cloud.

  • Optimise iPhone Storage

Your iPhone comes with a useful feature called "Optimize iPhone Storage," which automatically manages your photo and video storage. When enabled, it stores full-resolution photos and videos in iCloud while keeping smaller, device-friendly versions on your iPhone. To activate this feature, navigate to Settings > Photos > Optimize iPhone Storage.

  • Review and Delete Unused Apps

Over time, you may accumulate a collection of apps that you rarely or never use. Go through your apps and delete the ones you no longer need. To do this, press and hold the app icon on your home screen until it starts shaking, then tap the "X" button to delete. You can always re-download apps from the App Store if needed.

  • Clear Safari Cache and Data

The Safari browser can also contribute to storage issues as it stores website data and caches. To clear this data, go to Settings > Safari > Clear History and Website Data. This action will remove website history, cookies, and other browsing data, creating more space on your iPhone.

Samsung Phones

  • Uninstall Unused Apps

As with iPhones, unused apps can contribute to storage woes on Samsung devices. Go through your app drawer and uninstall apps that you no longer use. Simply press and hold the app icon, then select "Uninstall" or drag it to the "Uninstall" option.

  • Manage Offline Maps and Files

If you use offline maps or download files for offline use, these can take up a considerable amount of space. Go to Settings > Connections > Data usage > Download booster and review and manage your offline maps and files to free up storage.

  • Clear App Cache and Data

Over time, apps accumulate cached data that can take up a significant amount of storage. Navigate to Settings > Apps, select the app you want to manage and choose "Storage." Here, you can clear the cache or even delete the app's data if it's not critical.

  • Utilise Smart Storage

Samsung Galaxy devices come equipped with a feature called Smart Storage, which automatically removes unnecessary files, such as cached data and temporary files. To enable this feature, go to Settings > Device Care> Storage > Advanced > Smart Storage, and toggle it on.

Alternatively, you can visit our store and swap your phone for one with higher storage.

posts.title: MYTHBUSTER: 5 Myths about Airplane Mode
posts.content:
One of the ubiquitous features on our phones (and laptops) is Airplane Mode. For a lot of us, it’s our go-to feature to fix network issues; just toggling the switch can be the difference bee for those who travel by air, it’s one of the toggles they activate when flying. While its primary purpose is clear - to disable cellular and Wi-Fi connectivity during flights - several myths surround its functionalities and effects. Let's shed light on these common misconceptions:

Myth 1: Airplane mode significantly saves battery life.

Reality: While it's true that searching for signals can drain your battery, the impact is often exaggerated. Modern phones are optimized to minimize network-related battery drain. Airplane mode might extend your battery life by a small margin, but it won't offer a dramatic boost, especially if you're actively using other features like games or the camera.

Myth 2: Airplane mode prevents your phone from getting hacked.

Reality: Airplane mode primarily affects connectivity, not security. While it disables communication with external networks, it doesn't offer any inherent protection against malware or malicious websites you might encounter if you're still using Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. Always ensure you have reliable security software installed and practice safe browsing habits.

Myth 3: Airplane mode is required for faster charging.

Reality: This is another misconception. Modern fast charging technologies work independently of airplane mode and can efficiently recharge your phone even with network connectivity enabled. In fact, enabling airplane mode might add minimal charging time in certain scenarios.

Myth 4: Airplane mode wipes out downloaded content like movies or music.

Reality: Airplane mode only affects how your phone connects to external networks. Any content you've downloaded and stored on your device beforehand remains accessible, even when airplane mode is enabled. You can freely enjoy movies, music, podcasts, and other downloaded content during your flight.

Myth 5: Airplane mode is unnecessary because devices don't Interfere with aircraft systems

Reality: While modern devices are designed to minimize interference, Airplane Mode remains a precautionary measure. It ensures that no unexpected signals disrupt the intricate communication systems aboard aircraft, contributing to overall flight safety.

In conclusion, Airplane Mode is a versatile tool that goes beyond its initial aviation-focused design, So, the next time you activate Airplane Mode, remember that you're not just preparing for takeoff – you're unlocking or locking a range of functionalities designed to enhance your device's performance.

Which one had you fooled? Tell us in the comment section.

posts.title: Mythbuster: Refurbished iPhones are Fake
posts.content:
"Make sure you don’t buy a refurbished one" is arguably the most common advice you hear when you tell someone you want to get a new iPhone. For many people, a refurbished iPhone is either a fake iPhone or a faulty iPhone. Nothing could be further from the truth.

What is a Refurbished iPhone?

A refurbished iPhone is a pre-owned device that has gone through a renewal process. This typically involves:

  • Thorough cleaning and inspection
  • Replacing any faulty parts with genuine Apple components
  • Reinstalling the latest iOS version
  • Testing functionality to ensure it meets Apple's standards.

Are Refurbished iPhones Fake?

No way! Refurbished iPhones are genuine Apple devices. They've simply had a previous life and been given a second chance.

Here's why the "fake" rumour is off-base:

  • Apple sells certified refurbished iPhones: Apple itself refurbishes iPhones and sells them through their online store and authorized retailers. These phones come with a warranty, just like new iPhones.
  • Strict refurbishing process: Reputable refurbishers have a rigorous process to ensure they're only dealing with genuine iPhones. They often source their devices from trade-ins or returns.

Benefits of Refurbished iPhones

There are many reasons to consider a refurbished iPhone:

  • Significant savings: You can save hundreds of dollars compared to a brand-new iPhone.
  • Quality and warranty: Reputable sources ensure the iPhone functions properly and often back it with a warranty.

What to Consider When Buying Refurbished

  • Seller reputation: Do your research! Look for reputable vendors who offer warranties and have good customer reviews.
  • Cosmetic condition: Refurbished iPhones come in various grades, from "like new" to showing slight wear. Choose a condition that fits your budget and preferences.
  • Battery health: Make sure the battery health is good, especially for pre-owned devices.

Refurbished iPhones: A Smart Choice

Refurbished iPhones are a smart and budget-friendly way to get a great Apple device. They're genuine, reliable, and come with significant savings. Just be sure to buy from a reputable source and consider the condition and battery health before making your purchase.

posts.title: 8 Ways to Extend Your Phone Life
posts.content:
There is one undeniable fact: phones are expensive. With the dollar currently competing with NEPA, we are not sure if things are going to ever go back to how they used to be. So, if you are on a budget and you have a functional phone—one that is relatively modern and purring—it will be in your best interest to protect your phone. Fortunately, there are several practical steps you can take to elongate your phone's lifespan and get the most out of your investment. Here are eight tips to help you do just that

Invest in a Quality Case and Screen Protector

Shielding your phone from accidental drops and scratches is crucial for maintaining its pristine condition. A durable case and a high-quality screen protector can provide an extra layer of protection against everyday wear and tear.

Keep Your Phone Clean:

Dust, dirt, and grime can accumulate in the nooks and crannies of your phone, potentially causing damage over time. Regularly clean your device using a soft, microfiber cloth and gentle cleaning solutions to remove any debris and maintain optimal performance.

Optimize Battery Health:

The battery is often the first component to show signs of wear in a smartphone. To prolong its lifespan, avoid overcharging your phone and aim to keep its battery level between 20% and 80%. Additionally, consider using battery-saving modes and limiting resource-intensive tasks to reduce strain on the battery.

Update Software Regularly:

Software updates not only bring new features and improvements but also often include crucial security patches and bug fixes. Keeping your phone's operating system and apps up to date can help ensure smooth performance and protect against potential vulnerabilities.

Manage Storage Wisely:

Running out of storage space can slow down your phone and shorten its lifespan. Take the time to declutter your device regularly by deleting unnecessary files, apps, and photos. Consider offloading large media files to cloud storage or external drives to free up space and keep your phone running smoothly.

Avoid Extreme Temperatures:

Exposure to extreme temperatures, whether hot or cold, can adversely affect your phone's battery life and overall performance. Avoid leaving your device in direct sunlight or extreme cold for extended periods, as this can cause irreversible damage to internal components.

Handle with Care:

Treat your phone with the care it deserves to prevent physical damage and internal issues. Avoid exposing it to water, excessive pressure, or sudden impacts, and be mindful of how you handle and transport your device to minimize the risk of accidents.

Consider Professional Maintenance:

If you encounter persistent issues or notice a significant decline in performance, don't hesitate to reach out to Ogabassey Repairs. We can help you diagnose and address underlying problems, potentially saving you from more costly repairs or premature replacement. We have got you!

By following these tips, you can extend the lifespan of your phone and enjoy its benefits for years to come. Remember, a little care and maintenance can go a long way in preserving the functionality and value of your device. So, take the time to implement these practices into your routine and reap the rewards of a longer-lasting smartphone experience.

posts.title: Factory Unlocked iPhones: Explained
posts.content:
When shopping for a new iPhone, you might see the term "factory unlocked." What does this mean, and why should you care? In this guide, we'll explain everything about factory unlocked iPhones.

What is a Factory Unlocked iPhone?

A factory unlocked iPhone is a phone that is not locked to any network. It was bought from Apple or an authorized store. This means you can use it with any network provider by simply changing the SIM card. These phones are unlocked permanently, even after software updates.

Advantages of a Factory Unlocked iPhone

  1. Carrier Flexibility: You can choose any carrier you like. Switch between MTN, GLO 9mobile etc International Carriers like AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, or any other carrier would work perfectly.
  2. International Travel: Use a local SIM card when you travel. This saves you from high roaming fees and gives you better service.
  3. No Contracts: You're not tied to a long-term contract. Change carriers or plans anytime without penalties.
  4. Higher Resale Value: Unlocked iPhones sell for more money. Buyers prefer the flexibility of an unlocked phone.
  5. Dual SIM Capability: Factory unlocked iPhones often support dual SIM functionality. This can be in the form of dual physical SIMs or a combination of one physical SIM and one eSIM. This allows you to use two different numbers on the same device without compatibility issues.
  6. Network Compatibility: Make sure the iPhone model works with your preferred carrier's network.
  7. Warranty and Support: Buying from Apple or an authorized store ensures your phone has a warranty and support services.

How to Identify a Factory Unlocked iPhone

  1. SIM Check: Insert a SIM card from another carrier. If the phone works, it is most likely unlocked. Although it is also possible it is worldwide unlocked. If it doesn't work then it is Chip Unlocked.
  2. IMEI CHECKER: Use IMEI checkers online to check the lock status. We are currently building our checker on checks.ogabassey.com.
  3. Settings Check: Navigate to Settings>> General >> About >> Carrier Lock If you see "No Sim Restrictions" Then it is factory unlocked

Disadvantages of a Factory Unlocked iPhone

  1. Price: Factory unlocked iPhones can be more expensive upfront. They are more expensive than the carrier-locked iPhones. The benefits and flexibility might be worth the costs
  2. Financing Options: Unlike carrier-locked phones, which often come with financing options, you will need to pay the full price upfront for a factory unlocked phone.

Conclusion

Factory unlocked iPhones offer great flexibility. They are perfect for travelers, people who dislike contracts, or anyone who wants the latest updates and high resale value. A factory unlocked iPhone is a smart investment.
